whatsapp-automation.title: WhatsApp Business Automation in Azerbaijan: Step-by-Step Guide
whatsapp-automation.excerpt: Setting up a shared team inbox, verified template alerts, and managing 24-hour customer windows via Cloud API.
whatsapp-automation.body: WhatsApp is the primary messaging channel in Azerbaijan. Leveraging the official WhatsApp Cloud API allows entire sales teams to collaborate under one shared business number. Replies within the 24-hour customer service window incur zero message fees. For booking confirmations and reminders, pre-approved Meta templates ensure high deliverability without account bans. panelim.az manages these workflows out of the box.

instagram-dm-sales.title: Doubling Sales Conversions Through Instagram Direct Messages
instagram-dm-sales.excerpt: Proven techniques to funnel story reactions and direct messages into qualified CRM deals.
instagram-dm-sales.body: Inquiries from Instagram advertising campaigns carry high purchase intent, but response delays exceeding fifteen minutes drastically reduce close rates. Best practices require instant conversational qualification, immediate pricing guidance from approved tables, and automated trial scheduling. Unifying direct messages inside a structured team workspace ensures zero leads slip through unanswered.

appointment-crm.title: Appointment & Trial Class Management: Ending Overbooking
appointment-crm.excerpt: Transitioning from spreadsheets to atomic capacity protection, live rosters, and duplicate checks.
appointment-crm.body: Many training centers and service businesses track appointments in shared spreadsheets, creating duplicate bookings and classroom overflow. Modern booking engines lock seats atomically inside database transactions, guaranteeing that physical capacities are strictly respected. Duplicate submissions from the same normalized phone number are blocked, freeing managers to focus on confirmed prospects.

ai-reply-workflows.title: AI Reply Assistants in Sales: Guardrails and Best Practices
ai-reply-workflows.excerpt: Preventing hallucinations with strict price constraints and knowing when to escalate to staff.
ai-reply-workflows.body: Deploying AI assistants delivers 24/7 availability, but unconstrained models risk hallucinating unauthorized discounts or non-existent schedules. Safe architecture restricts the copilot to approved product tables and session records. Whenever a customer asks for customized pricing, policy exceptions, or expresses frustration, the assistant stops and escalates the conversation seamlessly to an agent.

telegram-lead-capture.title: Automating Customer Inquiries with Telegram Bots
telegram-lead-capture.excerpt: Connecting Telegram bot tokens to capture leads in seconds and route inquiries to your staff pipeline.
telegram-lead-capture.body: Telegram Bot API offers the fastest onboarding path for conversational intake. By connecting your bot token, your service desk goes live in under two minutes. Prospects browse course options, pick trial class dates, and receive instant confirmations. Every interaction feeds directly into the unified inbox and CRM pipeline, enabling your team to follow up smoothly.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Terms and conditions governing the use of panelim.az services.

intro.title: 1. General provisions
intro.body: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the panelim.az website and software platform. By using the platform, you agree to these terms in full.

account.title: 2. Workspace access & security
account.body: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their center access keys and for all activities within their workspace. Sharing credentials with unauthorized third parties is prohibited.

acceptable.title: 3. Acceptable use policy
acceptable.body: Using the platform for spam, unsolicited messaging, illegal material, or actions infringing upon the rights of others is strictly forbidden. Violations may result in immediate workspace termination.

fees.title: 4. Fees & communication tariffs
fees.body: Subscription fees follow the agreed service rates. Official WhatsApp Cloud API messaging tariffs charged by Meta or third-party telecom providers are billed separately and remain the responsibility of the customer.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of liability
liability.body: panelim.az implements diligent engineering measures to maintain uptime. However, the platform is not liable for disruptions originating from third-party provider outages or telecom network downtime.

contact.title: 6. Notices and inquiries
contact.body: Inquiries or notices regarding these terms should be directed to our team via the contact form on panelim.az.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Principles of personal data collection, processing, and protection.

collection.title: 1. Information we collect
collection.body: We collect contact information provided during registration (name, phone number) alongside conversation history and booking timestamps necessary to deliver the service.

purpose.title: 2. How information is used
purpose.body: Collected data is processed exclusively to handle customer communications, organize trial appointments, operate the CRM pipeline, and maintain technical platform security.

isolation.title: 3. Multi-tenant data isolation
isolation.body: Every customer workspace is maintained in an isolated database environment. Staff from one center cannot access another center's customer records, schedules, or chat logs under any circumstance.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-party integrations
thirdParty.body: Official communication protocols from Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and Telegram are used to route messages. Personal data is never sold or transferred to external third parties for advertising purposes.

retention.title: 5. Retention and user rights
retention.body: Data is retained for the duration of the active service relationship. Users may request correction, export, or deletion of their personal records and workspace at any time.

contact.title: 6. Privacy contact
contact.body: Questions or requests regarding this Privacy Policy and personal data handling may be submitted through the contact page on panelim.az.
